description.value: John Daly Park, also known as the John Daly Nature Reserve and by its Sechelt (Shíshálh) name ḵelx̱aminkwu, is a nature reserve managed by the Sunshine Coast Regional District on BC's Sunshine Coast. The park sits at 5930 Roosen Road and offers a natural green space in the region. Touring cyclists exploring the Sunshine Coast may find it a worthwhile scenic stop, though specific trail and facility details are not confirmed from available sources.
